pages.title: Retting
pages.text: Seal four Plant Fibre with 250 mB water in a barrel for 1200 ticks, or one minute, to receive four Retted Fibre. A water bottle provides exactly this fluid amount. Retting prepares fibre; Crude Cordage can be made earlier without retting.

pages.title: Spin and Bind
pages.text: A Hand Spindle turns two Retted Fibre into two Twine. Three compatible strings make Rope. Four strings and four loom passes make Cloth. Cordage, Twine, and Rope serve different recipe/tag roles; they are not interchangeable in every recipe.
